course_name_original: ESSENTIALS OF ECONOMICS AND BUSINESS ECONOMICS
course_name_en: Essentials of Economics and Business Economics
prerequisites: Mathematical: Knowledge of general mathematics elements.

learning_outcomes.text: Understand the economic behavior of subjects operating in product and production factor markets, with particular attention to that of businesses.
Possess knowledge of the economic principles underlying the functioning of markets.
Ability to use economic principles to understand the essential aspects of the functioning of an economic system.
Acquire basic knowledge of business economics, through the use of examples and exercises taken from real business operations.
Understand the structural and behavioral characteristics of different types of companies, with systemic logic: supply and production for market exchange.

Analyze the main management operations that characterize the life of companies, with particular reference to businesses, observing the dynamics of economic and financial flows and the conditions that characterize operating economically.

Present the basic elements of the company information system and of the accounting information subsystem, with reference to the logic of the surveys and quantitative determinations for the determination of operating income and working capital.
Provide elements for reading the financial statements of a commercial company.
Introduce the problem of the economic nature and the criteria for determining production costs.
Know and understand microeconomic models for analyzing consumer spending and business production decisions.
Understand the implications of market failures.
Understand economic-business phenomena and fundamental accounting methods and tools.
Acquire a language specific to economic-business disciplines.
Analyze the production decisions of companies to understand the real dynamics taking place in the markets.
Learn the basic elements relating to company accounting systems.
Provide the essential elements for reading and understanding the financial statements.
Interpret data relating to real market dynamics and express autonomous judgments on the implications deriving from the choices of economic agents.
Improve the ability to interpret accounting results, to formulate independent judgments and solutions, and to interpret data of economic-business relevance, also through examples.
Improve communication skills through open-ended questions and the optional oral test.
Develop the skills necessary to take further exams, particularly in economics and professional accounting subjects.

syllabus_topics: Supply and demand: how markets work
The economics of the public sector
Inefficient market allocations and market failures
Introduction to the course - The company
The growth of the company / The environment
The different stages of business management
The analysis of the economic and financial aspects of management
The concepts of effectiveness and efficiency
The logic of quantitative business records
The financial statements of business enterprises, content and purpose

assessment_methods.method: Written test consisting of open-ended questions

assessment_rules: The exam score is expressed in thirtieths. A minimum score of 18/30 is required for passing, demonstrating elementary subject knowledge. For 30/30 with possible honors, the student must logically and coherently systematize acquired knowledge, supporting the analysis with excellent elaboration and mastery of technical and economic language.
bibliography: Mankiw, G. e Taylor M., Principi di Economia, Zanichelli, Ottava Edizione italiana. 2022
G. Melis, Elementi di economia aziendale (IV edition), Giuffrè, 2022.
degree: Laurea in Ingegneria Meccanica E Gestionale (First Level Degree In Mechanical And Management Engineering), classe L-9 Classe delle lauree in Ingegneria industriale
